title: AAMC Core Entrustable Professional Activities for Entering Residency
source: Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC), Core EPAs for Entering Residency. Day-one-of-residency expectation: perform the Core EPAs without direct supervision.
scale_note: Supervision (entrustment) scale. Schools may use a finer-grained version; edit 'scale' to match yours.

scale.label: Observe only
scale.meaning: Not yet trusted to perform this activity; may observe.

scale.label: Direct supervision
scale.meaning: May perform with a supervisor physically present and ready to step in.

scale.label: Indirect supervision
scale.meaning: May perform with a supervisor quickly available; findings are reviewed afterwards.

epas.title: Gather a history and perform a physical examination
epas.simulation_note: History-taking and communication only; no physical exam in this simulation.

epas.title: Prioritize a differential diagnosis following a clinical encounter
epas.simulation_note: Only if the student states an assessment or differential during the encounter.

epas.title: Recommend and interpret common diagnostic and screening tests
epas.simulation_note: Reviewing the chart's labs and vitals, explaining them, and suggesting follow-up tests.

epas.title: Enter and discuss orders and prescriptions
Document a clinical encounter in the patient record
Provide an oral presentation of a clinical encounter
Form clinical questions and retrieve evidence to advance patient care
Give or receive a patient handover to transition care responsibility
Collaborate as a member of an interprofessional team
epas.simulation_note: Appropriate referrals and coordination with other professionals and community resources.

epas.title: Recognize a patient requiring urgent or emergent care and initiate evaluation and management
epas.simulation_note: Recognising and acting on red-flag symptoms the patient reports.

epas.title: Obtain informed consent for tests and/or procedures
Perform general procedures of a physician
Identify system failures and contribute to a culture of safety and improvement

rubric_map._about: Which EPAs each rubric domain provides evidence toward. Evidence is partial: a simulated interview shows only part of each EPA.
